args: Assess an UPRIGHT pinch of the TWO PHYSICAL SHORT END WALLS, closing along the long axis, NOT the rejected long-side strips or near-horizontal routes. Request t0..t3 at the supplied SAME physical IDs; declare landmark_identity. Request c0..c2 on noncollinear counter. Request a0,a1 as upper/lower samples on one SHORT END wall and b0,b1 on the OPPOSITE end, with complementary views/radius 1 as needed. Occluded faces are unknown. Give four top-edge pixels in one camera, ordered A-strip-end1,A-strip-end2,B-strip-end2,B-strip-end1, delimiting aligned end-contact strips about 25 mm wide. No whole perimeter. Request s0..s3: fresh top interiors spanning both directions; declare sN_surface individually. These support the plane, not new t IDs. Upright orientation alone does not resolve the old height deficit; an infeasible interval prevents approach. Note any visible presentation alternative without authorizing it.

historical_failure.guard_accounting: Counter bound includes guard plus pose tolerance plus the original 3 mm clearance. Overlap includes guard plus pose tolerance above 5 mm and never lowers the rejected candidate's 7 mm nominal threshold. Top floor uses the lowest measured upper corner, not the higher center. The interval is for the planned orientation; actual finger orientation and margins are rechecked before closure.
historical_failure.candidate_change: Choose a lower height inside a measured feasible interval with a tighter pose deadband, not a lowered clearance or overlap threshold.
reference_top_ids: t0: inner curl of the large initial capital C in the printed word Cream, toward the exposed short end.
t1: inner curl of the large initial capital C in the printed word Cheese, below Cream in this view.
t2: initial F of the smaller printed Fresh Taste line, left of the large lettering in this view.
t3: terminal e of the smaller printed Fresh Taste line, toward the inward end of that line.

excluded_route.family: near-horizontal long-side entry at +/-88 and +/-90 degrees
excluded_route.established_obstruction: Palm intersects counter during descent; high alignment alone was clear.

result.explanation: Observation/model assessment only; no approach or closure is authorized. Current and earlier images show the same package flat on the counter and an empty open hand. The rise exposed the previously palm-masked far top edge, not the far vertical short-end wall. A is the short end at the upper wrist-image edge and lower agentview edge; its wall is visible in agentview. Opposite B's vertical wall is hidden behind the package in both views, so b0/b1 and a B-wall region cannot be supplied. This is unobserved geometry, not an observed external obstruction. Visible features support local short-end top-edge strips, not verified opposed-wall contacts. Upright orientation alone does not remove the supplied height deficit: all supplied guarded intervals fail their minimum-width test. A newly measured feasible interval is required before approach. No raised or overhanging end is visible. The exposed broad top could inform a separately assessed presentation change, but no such action is authorized. Rejected near-horizontal routes remain excluded.

parameters.notes: Edge order: A-strip-end1,A-strip-end2,B-strip-end2,B-strip-end1. Centered transverse spans are approximately 25 mm; verify metric widths with depth. These are short-end strips, not long-side strips or the whole perimeter. t0..t3 retain the supplied printed-feature identities. s0..s3 are fresh top-plane samples, not new t IDs. a0/a1 are upper/lower A-wall samples. b0/b1 are unavailable because B's vertical wall is object-occluded. The earlier wrist palm mask was robot self-occlusion. Continue means assessment only, not approach authorization.
